info.title: ae/language
info.description: Language selection and message lookup for every platform, and a generator of platform string resources for English, French, German and Spanish. Web: implementation/web/i18n.ts. Apple: implementation/apple/Sources/Language.swift. Android: package ae.i18n. Generator: implementation/scripts/generate.py.

methods.name: selectLanguage
methods.description: The requested language when supported, else the part before its first hyphen when supported, else the fallback; case is kept (fr-CA against en, fr gives fr). Web: selectLanguage in web/i18n.ts. Swift: selectLanguage(_:supported:fallback:). Kotlin: ae.i18n.selectLanguage(requested, supported, fallback) and AppLanguage.selectLanguage.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: The stored text for a key (own keys only; an empty string counts as present), or the key itself. Web: lookup in web/i18n.ts. Swift: lookup(_:key:). Kotlin: ae.i18n.lookup(messages, key) and AppLanguage.lookup.

methods.name: parseLanguages
methods.description: The languages setting as a list, checked: at least one name, none repeated, every name in known. Web only (web/i18n.ts); the generator's parse_languages also requires en.

errors.message: languages must be distinct names from <known>

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Writes platform resources for the chosen languages from a string table: web strings.json, Apple Localizable.xcstrings and Android values*/strings.xml, with native placeholders numbered in English first-appearance order. Python only: generate(strings, web, apple, android_root, languages) in scripts/generate.py, or its command line --strings --web --apple --android [--languages]. Nothing is written when a check fails.

params.name: languages
params.description: Command line form; the Python function takes a tuple.

errors.message: languages must be distinct names from en fr de es and include en
string table must be a nonempty object
each key requires <languages> and no other language than en, fr, de, es

Language.description: A language the generator knows: English, French, German, Spanish.

LanguagesSetting.description: The languages installer setting: distinct names from en fr de es separated by spaces; en must be listed.

Messages.description: Message key to text in one language; an empty string is present text.

additionalProperties.description: Every chosen language (en always); placeholders are {name} and every language uses the same set.

StringTable.description: The application's string table the generator reads: resource key to its text per language.

WebStrings.description: The generated web strings.json: language to its messages.
